If it be demaunded, what is the Occasion of this kind of temptation? I answer, that it ariseth sometimes, vpon the commission of some notorious sinne, which doth wound the conscience, as in Cain, Iudas, and Saul, who for their great and capitall sinnes, that stinged and wounded their consciences, grew to a fearefull state, and consequently perished in this temptation. Sometimes againe
it comes when there is no sinne committed, but obedience to God performed: and then there cannot be rendered any reason of it, either in man, or out of man, saue this, that God will haue it so to be. And the truth hereof is plaine by the examples of Iob and Dauid before mentioned.
